name: reverse gravity
lore:
### Codex Arcanum: *Inversio Gravitas*

To cast *Inversio Gravitas* is to seize the very foundations of the world and turn them inside out. As you shape the Weave, you will feel a sickening lurch in your marrow—a phantom vertigo as the threads of "Down" are violently unspooled and re-anchored to the heavens.

Visually, the effect is a shimmering distortion, like heat rising from sun-baked stone. Within the affected zone, the natural order fails. Dust, debris, and panicked foes do not merely float; they *fall* toward the stars with terminal velocity. 

Legend attributes this discovery to the Archmage Valerius, who sought a way to walk among the clouds without the burden of wings. During the Siege of Aethelgard, trapped at the cliff’s edge, Valerius did not leap to his death. He simply adjusted his perspective. His pursuers were cast into the infinite blue, their terrified cries swallowed by the sky. To master this spell is to recognize that the earth is not a floor, but merely a suggestion.
